This form is used to enter the selections that will appear on a menu.
The menu must be defined using the ADD_FCN form before entering data on
this form.
The user is shown the main menu for the selected application.
--
[Nxtblk] To navigate to the lower level menu.
[Prvblk] To navigate to the higher level menu.
[KeyMenu] To move a menu item
--
Up to 99 selections can be placed on a menu. A function can be put onto
more than one menu (EXCEPTION: functions of type MENU can only be on one
menu, because of navigation restrictions), but must be identified by a
unique mnemonic each time it appears.
The number associated with a menu selection controls the sequence of that
selection when that menu is displayed on the SYSMENU form (the numbers
are not absolute, as a user may not have access to all items).
The description that is entered here will appear as the text associated
with the selection when SYSMENU is executed.
If parameter names were entered when the function was defined with the
ADD_FCN form, those parameter names will appear in the MENU_ITEM block.
The user must enter the values to be associated with those parameters (e.g.,
the parameter name might be TEST_ID, and the user might enter CMV for the
value to be identified with that parameter for this specific menu selection)
.

Trigger.Name: WHEN-VALIDATE-ITEM
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 t_fcn_id number(6);
 t_descrip VARCHAR2(40);
 t_exec_name VARCHAR2(20);
begin
 if :global.query = 'YES'
 then
 return;
 end if;
--
 begin
 select fcn_id,descrip
 into t_fcn_id ,t_descrip
 from menu_item
 where mnemonic = :menu_item.mnemonic
 and appl_id = :ctrl_block_1.appl_id
 and fcn_id != nvl(:menu_item.fcn_id,0) ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null;
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
--
 if t_fcn_id is not null
 then
 begin
 select exec_name
 into t_exec_name
 from fcn
 where fcn_id = t_fcn_id
 and appl_id = :ctrl_block_1.appl_id;
 exception
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 message ('Err: Duplicate mnemonic for '|| t_exec_name || ' : '
 || t_descrip );
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.TriggerText:
begin

 then
 begin

 into :GLOBAL.x
 from MENU_ITEM
 where FCN_ID = :MENU_ITEM.FCN_ID
 and appl_id = :ctrl_block_1.appl_id
 and MENU_ID != :MENU_ITEM.MENU_ID;

Trigger.Name: KEY-COMMIT
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 new_acc_lvl VARCHAR2(40) := NULL;
begin
 first_record;
 for ctr in 1..40
 loop
 if ctr = to_number(substr(:group.grp_id,4,2)) + 1
 then
 new_acc_lvl := new_acc_lvl || to_char(:group.acc_flag);
 else
 new_acc_lvl := new_acc_lvl || '0';
 end if;
 exit when :system.last_record = 'TRUE';
 down;
 end loop;
 if new_acc_lvl != :menu_item.acc_lvl
 then
 :menu_item.acc_lvl := new_acc_lvl;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: ON-ERROR
Trigger.TriggerText:
begin
 if error_code = 40100 -- at first record
 then
 show_error('1700');
 elsif error_code = 40102 -- record must be entered first
 then
 show_error('1701');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('1702');
 elsif error_code = 40201 -- field is full
 then
 show_error('1703');
 elsif error_code = 40202 -- field must be entered
 then
 show_error('0080');
 elsif error_code = 40207 -- must be in range
 then
 show_error('1704');
 elsif error_code = 40208 -- form in query mode, cant update
 then
 show_error('1705');
 elsif error_code = 40200 -- field protected against update
 then
 show_error('5050');
 elsif error_code in (40400,40406,40407)-- transaction committed
 then
 show_error('8010');
 elsif error_code = 40401 -- no changes to commit
 then
 show_error('8013');
 elsif error_code in (50002,50003,50004, -- invalid date
 50011,50012,50021,50023,50026)
 then
 show_error('1706');
 elsif error_code in (50006,50007,50009, -- invalid number
 50013,50014,50015,50016,50020)
 then
 show_error('1707');
 elsif error_code in (50017,50018,50019,50022) -- invalid time
 then
 show_error('5016');
 elsif error_code in ('0') -- invalid format
 then
 show_error('0022',GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK)); 
 elsif error_code='41011' then --LAF suppression
 null;
 else
 message(substr(error_type||'-'||to_char (error_code)
 ||': '||error_text,1,80));
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
